title: Asiad: Mangin bows to Chinese foe, pockets taekwondo silver
summary: Filipina taekwondo jin Tachiana Mangin will bring home a silver medal from her first-ever Asian Games after losing to her Chinese opponent in the final on Friday night at the Toyohashi Gymnasium.
